FactionDef.label: security corporation
FactionDef.description: A corporation that sells safety: guards, ICE and the hunters behind it. Its nodes are thick with ICE, and its raids hit hard.

FactionDef.label: media corporation
FactionDef.description: A corporation of feeds, stars and braindance studios. Its vaults hold recordings, and its rumors fill the news.

FactionDef.label: biotech corporation
FactionDef.description: A corporation that edits life. Its data is dense and valuable, and its attacks come as neural noise.

FactionDef.label: neurotech corporation
FactionDef.description: A corporation of implants and minds. It hoards unique recordings and chips, and knows how to make a cyberlink hurt.

FactionDef.label: finance corporation
FactionDef.description: A corporation of money and ledgers. Its vaults are full of silver, and it takes a toll on every link it owns.

FactionDef.label: logistics corporation
FactionDef.description: A corporation of routes and freight. Its fast backbone lines run everywhere, and it steals data straight from warehouses.

FactionDef.label: arms corporation
FactionDef.description: A corporation of weapons. Its vaults hold guns, and its raiders come better equipped.

FactionDef.label: energy corporation
FactionDef.description: A corporation of grids and reactors. It attacks with power surges and can switch whole nodes off.

FactionDef.label: pharma corporation
FactionDef.description: A corporation of drugs and cures. Its vaults hold medicine and neurostabilizers.

FactionDef.label: data broker corporation
FactionDef.description: A corporation that buys and sells secrets. Its loot is maps and dark links, and it trades leaks in the news.

FactionDef.label: orbital corporation
FactionDef.description: A corporation that lives above the sky. Its nodes and its fortress are in orbit.
